svg.title: Linux folders cheat sheet: what lives where (on our BeagleBone OpenBMC image)
svg.text: Our BeagleBone OpenBMC image. Colours tell you where a folder really is, and what survives a reboot or a re-flash.
Root partition: the image's own files
In RAM: empty after every reboot
Made by the kernel (not real files)
